title: SERVICES PROVIDED BY SCHOOL HEALTH SCHEME | Directorate General of Health Services
description: School Health Scheme provides following services to school going children of GNCT of Delhi:
content: SERVICES PROVIDED BY SCHOOL HEALTH SCHEME | Directorate General of Health Services Skip to main content A + A A - A A Login Directorate General of Health Services Government of NCT of Delhi SERVICES PROVIDED BY SCHOOL HEALTH SCHEME Home/ School Health Scheme/ SERVICES PROVIDED BY SCHOOL HEALTH SCHEME School Health Scheme provides following services to school going children of GNCT of Delhi: Screening for deficiencies, diseases & disabilities of all children. First-aid care services. Linkage with hospitals in case of emergencies & referral Treatment and Curative services through OPD services. Follow- up of referred children. Health awareness session on various health topics like- WIFS, Mass De-worming, seasonal diseases, nutritional awareness etc. Synergizing with programmes of health Deptt. School Mental Health programme (Drug and substance abuse) Implementation of Weekly Iron Folic Acid Supplementation (WIFS) programme Implementation of annual De-worming programme Provision of First Aid services in schools Capacity building of Nodal teachers in BLS and first aid has been done . The principal activity of the cell is to carry out registration and renewal of registration every third year. The applications are received and processed. Inspections are carried out to see that the nursing homes maintain the standards and norms as per the Rules in the said Act. Efforts are made to prevent the functioning of the nursing homes providing inferior quality and suggesting appropriate action against the unregistered nursing homes. Top
